A 45-year-old male patient is preparing for a skiing expedition at a resort situated at an elevation of
9600 feet. Given his history of developing high-altitude pulmonary edema during his previous visit to
the same location, which of the following medications would be the most appropriate preventive
measure? Answer Choices: (A) Nifedipine (B) Iloprost (C) Dexamethasone (D) Budesonide (E)
Bosentan (F) Acetazolamide (G) Salmeterol (H) Tadalafil (I) Sildenafil (J) Ibuprofen
 A. Iloprost
B. Budesonide
C. Dexamethasone
D. Sildenafil
E. Nifedipine
F. Salmeterol
G. Bosentan
H. Tadalafil
I. Ibuprofen
J. Acetazolamide
